summary: One request added people to a campaign: the line counts what happened to its items and names the people it added.

added.description: Items that made a person a member of the campaign.

already_member.description: Items naming a person the campaign already held.

rejected.description: Items refused, each answered with its error in the response.

contact_ids.description: The people added, in the order of the request; empty when nobody was.

created_contact_ids.description: Those of the people added that the request also created in the contact directory.
